description:
Welcome to Donna Fixes!

I'm Donna. For forty-one years I kept four hundred Chicago apartments warm, running and paid for. I'm sixty-seven and retired now, living on my own, and this channel is where I pass it on.

Here you'll find:
• How to keep your house warm in winter and cool in summer for less
• Small changes that make a home safer and easier to live in after 60
• What's worth buying for your home, and what isn't
• Now and then, one cheap trick that saves a service call

Plain talk, no brand deals, and nothing that needs a ladder.

Subscribe and let’s get fixing!
